newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks firm in quieter trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks firm in quieter trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks firmed on Wednesday in somewhat quieter trade.
* Nine of 11 active issues rose, one fell and one was flat.
* Volume down at 9,217 shares, turnover also lower at 5.2 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Riviera gained 39 kuna to close at 145, selling 76 shares in a first deal since early December.
* The only decliner was chocolate maker Kras, down 20 kuna to 520 on volume of 464 shares.
* Most active Zagrebacka Banka gained 30 kuna to 1,230, selling 3,080 units.
